name: Protobi Claude MCP
description: Protobi AI Connector allows your AI engine to direct find and query data in your Protobi projects.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Protobi Claude MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Protobi Claude MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fly.protobi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Protobi Claude MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protobi Claude MCP provides these MCP tools: datasets, execute_query, list_elements, and semantic_search_elements.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Protobi Claude MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Protobi Claude MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Protobi Claude MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protobi Claude MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Protobi Claude MCP is developed by Protobi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
